title: The four seasons
examples: What clothes do we wear in the summer?
Does the weather change in each season?
What happens to the trees in autumn?

explain.say: Today we will learn about the four seasons. The seasons change all the time. They help us know what to expect.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: Earth's tilt and the seasons. Can you see the sun and the tilted axis? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
Spring is when things start to grow. Little green shoots pop out of the ground. Flowers open up everywhere for us to see.
Summer is the warmest time of year. We often play outside when the sun shines brightly. We might see sunshine and heat.
Autumn is when leaves change color. The trees turn beautiful shades of red and gold. Sometimes we see crunchy leaves falling down.
Winter is the coldest season for us. Sometimes we see white snow covering the ground. We need warm coats to stay cozy.
When you see a playground covered in colorful leaves, you are seeing autumn. The falling leaves show the season changing. This reminds us that seasons change all the time.

faq.a: Spring comes after winter. Spring means that life is starting to grow again. You might also ask what follows winter, or what season starts after snow.
asks: What season follows the cold time?

faq.q: Do the seasons happen in a certain order?
faq.a: Yes, the seasons happen in a set order. They go from spring to summer, then to autumn, and finally to winter. You can also ask what is the order of seasons, or what is the cycle of seasons.
asks: Does it always go spring to summer?
Can you name the seasons in order?

faq.q: What clothes do we wear in the summer?
faq.a: In the summer, we wear light and cool clothes. Things like shorts and t-shirts are good for the warm weather. You could also ask what to wear when it is hot.
asks: Should I wear heavy coats in summer?
What is good clothing for summer?

faq.q: Why do the leaves change color in autumn?
faq.a: The leaves change color because the weather gets cooler. The trees prepare for the cold time coming up. You might also ask why leaves turn red, or what happens to leaves in fall.
asks: Why are leaves yellow in fall?
Do leaves just fall down in autumn?

faq.q: Is the weather always the same in one season?
faq.a: No, the weather can change even within one season. One day might be sunny, and the next day might be rainy. You can also ask if the weather is predictable, or if weather changes much.
asks: Can the weather change in spring?
Is the weather always sunny in summer?
Does the weather change a lot?

facts: There are four main seasons throughout the year.
Spring brings new life and blooming flowers.
Summer is usually the warmest season.
Autumn is known for changing leaf colors.
Winter is the coldest season, sometimes with snow.

quiz.say: When do you wear heavy coats and scarves?
quiz.why: Winter is the coldest season, so you need warm clothes.

wrong.1: Summer is the warmest time, so heavy coats are too much.
wrong.2: Spring is getting warmer, so coats are not always needed.
wrong.3: Autumn is cool, but not as cold as winter.

quiz.say: What season is best for playing in shorts and t-shirts?
quiz.why: Summer is the warmest season, perfect for light clothes.

wrong.0: Spring is changing, and sometimes it is still a bit chilly.
wrong.2: Winter is too cold for shorts and t-shirts.
wrong.3: Autumn can be cool, so shorts might be too warm.

quiz.say: Which season follows the time when leaves turn red and gold?
quiz.why: Autumn is followed by winter in the yearly cycle.

wrong.0: The season after autumn is winter.
wrong.2: Spring comes after winter, not after autumn.
